committee: Joint Select Committee on Tribal Relations
location: Central Wyoming College, Intertribal Community Center, Room 125 2660 Peck Ave
title: The purpose of this meeting is to finalize the Select Committees interim work. The Select Committee will receive reports, updates, and have discussion on: 1) tribal and state development efforts; 2) education update; 3) State/Tribal cooperation accords; 4) State/Tribal collaboration on health issues; 5) minors' access to alcohol; 6) acquiring rights-of-way on the Wind River Reservation; and 7) notification for cultural and historical sites.
